rules: Slips are built around the mismatches: at least half the legs come from strong matchups where the game has them.
Each leg is set by its matchup: a strong mismatch steps up a rung (66%+), a neutral matchup takes a floor rung (75%+), a weak one stays conservative (80%+).
Every props leg is a rung a sportsbook lists, at its listed price; receptions start at 2+.
At most one leg under 65% and at most 2 legs per player.
Props slips carry no touchdown leg; SGP + anytime TD slips carry exactly one, from a scorer the algorithm clears for parlays.
